name: Rábacsanak (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of green and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábacsanak: a blue shield with a white church and a red heart, below a scroll inscribed RÁBACSANAK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of green and blue triangles
